name: OrthoFace
summary:
Explore facial geometry with OrthoFace, an educational workspace for 3D review and reversible colour visualization.

Load the labelled canonical teaching model or import an OrthoFace frame JSON. Review a 468-point face mesh, regional asymmetry, 50 proportional relationships and selectable geometric masks. Rotate, tilt, zoom and inspect the model with reference planes and axes.

Try reversible painting, mirrored colour, fill, eraser and Undo/Redo. Original REAL geometry remains distinct from the apparent FIT
